strategies.name: Supertrend (10, 3), long only
strategies.desc: Long while Supertrend points up, flat when it flips down.

strategies.name: Supertrend (10, 3), long and short
strategies.desc: Always in the market: long in an uptrend, short in a downtrend (as with index futures).

strategies.name: EMA 20/50 crossover, long only
strategies.desc: Long while the 20-day EMA is above the 50-day, flat otherwise.

strategies.name: RSI pullback in uptrend
strategies.desc: Buy when RSI(14) dips below 40 while price is above the 200-day EMA; sell when RSI tops 60 or price closes below the 200-day EMA.

strategies.name: Above 200-day EMA
strategies.desc: Long only while price is above its 200-day EMA, flat below it.
